use default

let order = 3

filled(x: int, y: int) -> bool =>
    (let across mut = x
     let down mut = y

     let solid mut = true

     while across > 0 \/ down > 0 do
         if across % 3 == 1 /\ down % 3 == 1 then
             solid = false
         fi

         across = across / 3
         down = down / 3
     od

     solid)

let size = (0..order) |> reduce(1, (total, _) => total * 3)

for down in 0..size do
    write_line(
        (0..size)
            |> map(across => if filled(across, down) then "#" else " " fi)
            |> join("")
    )
